caption: The drawing depicts a brass candlestick rendered in color on the right side, characterized by a wide, flared rim, a vertically symmetrical, turned shaft with various curves and ridges, and a broad, stepped square base. The candlestick is shaded with tones of gold and brown to represent brass material and shadow. To the left of the colored illustration are two technical line drawings of the same candlestick: one shows the object in profile using simple black lines, and the other shows a top-down view of the square base. Below these technical drawings, there is a small scale for measurement. The background is a plain light beige or cream color, and the drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border. The name "P. Johnson" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
